summary.en: Step-by-step guide with the result up front and a check at the end.
summary.de: Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung mit Ergebnis am Anfang und Kontrolle am Ende.

audience: People who want to get a task done
tone: Practical, short imperative sentences, no filler

structure.purpose: What the viewer will have at the end
Steps, one action per scene, in order
The expected result and how to recognise it
The most common mistake and its fix
Recap of the steps in one line each

rules: One action per step; name exact button, command or value.
Show the expected result after the last step.
Do not skip steps the viewer cannot guess.
avoid: Steps that depend on knowledge never stated.
Optional detours in the main path.
